about:
Graybar operates a location in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, as part of a nationwide network that spans all 50 U.S. states. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not disclosed in the available sources.

The company functions as a distributor of electrical and industrial products, maintaining a portfolio of subsidiaries that include Advantage Industrial Automation, American Electric Supply, Blazer Electric Supply, Broken Arrow Electric Supply, Cape Electrical Supply, CX Connexion, Graybar Canada, Metro Electric Supply, Metro Lighting, Samson Electrical Supply, Shepherd Electric Supply, Shingle & Gibb Automation, Steven Engineering, Valin Corporation, and Walker Industrial Products. Through these entities, Graybar supplies automation components, electrical equipment, lighting systems, and engineered solutions. The scale of its operation is reflected in its coast-to-coast store footprint, though specific facility sizes, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

Graybar's subsidiary network serves industries such as industrial automation, electrical construction, commercial lighting, and general manufacturing. Customers include contractors, original equipment manufacturers, and maintenance operations that source products through the company's local branches and specialized subsidiaries.

The company has not publicly stated a specific founding mission or differentiator beyond its broad geographic reach and multi-brand portfolio.
